entropy_reference_protocol.cdf: F0(x)=count(pooled correct TRAIN token entropies<=x)/total pooled correct TRAIN token count
entropy_reference_protocol.claim_scope: secondary ranking only; teacher-forced archived answers; no token independence theorem or independent-verifier gap closure
entropy_reference_protocol.dependence: record per-answer token count, lag1 correlation when support/variance permit, ties, mean/max entropy and all scores
entropy_reference_protocol.directions: larger CES, mean entropy, max entropy and probability_length error probability predict error
entropy_reference_protocol.empty_support: exclude empty answers; report original900 slots and empty exclusions separately
entropy_reference_protocol.invalid_draws: class absent => affected interval unavailable; retain counts; never drop or redraw
entropy_reference_protocol.missing_head: blocks head contrast only; mean/max comparisons remain
entropy_reference_protocol.reference_labels: original A1==0, nonempty answers only; no CAL or TEST response
entropy_reference_protocol.selection: no TEST tuning, probability threshold, learned feature or online arm
entropy_reference_protocol.signal_gate: every contrast one-sided lower bound>0; completion separate from effect
entropy_reference_protocol.unit: paired TEST100 qids; retain all original siblings
entropy_reference_protocol.weighting: token weighted; retain token count and distinct qid support
